verdict.rationale: A published OpenAPI spec exists at docs.coderabbit.ai/openapi.json, the official CLI can trigger reviews, `.coderabbit.yaml` (including central config) covers configuration as code, and `@coderabbitai` commands drive review actions, so parts of the product are scriptable outside the UI. Nothing shows the API covering UI surfaces such as Triage queue actions, saved views, the Dashboard metrics or Change Stack, so UI parity is unproven. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints and their scope, evidence of API coverage for Triage/Dashboard/Change Stack/settings, an explicit parity statement, and independent confirmation that the API is usable.
